instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Strict adherence to PMS tokens: Primary Orange #F26B33, Action Green #329937, Dark #1A1A1A, Surface #F7F7F7, Cards #FFFFFF, Borders #E5E5E5.
2. NEVER use Tailwind default green #22C55E or blue #3B82F6 or Slate family.
3. Implement ALL required data-testid attributes on cards, buttons, dropdowns, table rows, and preset pills using kebab-case.
4. For OD-363-07: Always display the 'Room status as of now' badge on Section F for historical dates.
5. For OD-363-08: Renders '—' safely whenever guest_name or room_code is null.
6. For OD-366-08: Build a clear visual comparison banner / switcher showing Option A (Side-by-Side) and Option B (Toggle Switch) so the owner can review both.
7. Recharts must use brand colors (#F26B33 for Sales/Booked, #329937 for Collected/Revenue, #F4A11A for F&B).
8. Maintain pure JS files (.jsx / .js) per project conventions.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.depth: Layered design with z-index hierarchy and clean borders
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.micro_interactions: Smooth transition-colors and hover states on buttons and tables
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Generous spacing (p-4 to p-6 inside card containers)
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_emoji: Use Lucide React icons instead of raw emojis
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case
